name: Country cottage
request: Build a cozy country cottage with stone foundations, timber-framed walls, a steep spruce roof with a chimney, flower boxes under the windows, a small vegetable garden, and a picket fence.

name: Modern villa
request: Build a two-story modern villa with white concrete walls, large glass windows, a flat roof terrace, a pool along one side, and a minimal garden with a few trees.

name: Treehouse
request: Build a big oak treehouse with a thick trunk, a wide leafy canopy, a wooden cabin among the branches, a ladder up the trunk, and a lookout platform.

name: Farm and barn
request: Build a farm with a red barn with a gambrel roof, a farmhouse, fenced animal pens, crop fields with water channels, a silo, and a dirt path connecting everything.

name: Medieval castle
request: Build a medieval castle with four corner towers, crenellated curtain walls, a gatehouse, a central keep, a courtyard with a well, and banners on the walls.

name: Wizard tower
request: Build a tall wizard tower of stone with purple accents, a pointed spire roof, glowing windows, a balcony near the top, and floating crystals around the spire.

name: Cliff lighthouse
request: Build a lighthouse on a cliff with a tall red and white striped tower, a big lantern room at the top, the keeper's house, a staircase cut into the rock, and a small jetty.

name: Gothic cathedral
request: Build a gothic cathedral with a long nave, pointed arches, tall stained glass windows, two bell towers with spires, buttresses along the sides, and a rose window over the entrance.

name: Medieval village
request: Build a small medieval village of six varied houses around a market square with a well, market stalls, a tavern, paths, gardens, and street lanterns.

name: Fishing harbour
request: Build a fishing harbour with wooden docks on posts, two small boats, a fish market hall, stacked barrels and crates, and fishermen's huts along the shore.

name: Japanese temple
request: Build a Japanese temple with a curved multi-tier roof, a red torii gate, a stone path lined with lanterns, a koi pond with a small bridge, and cherry trees.

name: Windmill
request: Build a traditional windmill with a stone base, a tapered wooden tower, four large sails, a small grain store, and wheat fields around it.

name: Giant ancient tree
request: Build a giant ancient tree with a huge twisted trunk, exposed roots, wide branches, a dense layered canopy, hanging vines, and lanterns tucked between the roots.

name: Formal garden
request: Build a formal garden with symmetric hedges, gravel paths, a central fountain, patterned flower beds, benches, and an arched pergola.

name: Lake and waterfall
request: Build a rocky hill with a waterfall falling into a clear lake, mossy boulders, reeds, a small wooden bridge, and trees around the shore.

name: Floating island
request: Build a floating island with a rocky underside that tapers to a point, grass and trees on top, a small cottage, and a waterfall pouring off one edge.

name: Stone dragon
request: Build a large stone dragon statue curled on a rock, with spread wings, a long tail, horns, glowing eyes, and scales in mixed stone tones.

name: Spaceship
request: Build a sleek spaceship on landing legs with a cockpit window, engines that glow at the back, wings, a boarding ramp, and panel details on the hull.

name: Steampunk laboratory
request: Build a steampunk laboratory with copper walls and pipes, a glass dome, chimneys, gear-like details, workbenches inside, and lanterns.

name: Witch's lair
request: Build a crooked witch's hut on stilts in a swamp, with a dark roof, a cauldron, hanging lanterns, mushrooms, and twisted trees around it.

name: Monumental bridge
request: Build a monumental stone bridge with tall arches, towers at each end, lamp posts along the deck, and decorative railings.

name: Monumental fountain
request: Build a monumental fountain with tiered basins, statues, water flowing from the top, a decorative plaza, and benches around it.

name: Pyramid
request: Build an ancient sandstone pyramid with stepped sides, a pillared entrance, carved patterns, two obelisks, and a guardian statue in front.

name: Airship
request: Build an airship with a large balloon envelope, a wooden gondola deck with railings, propellers, ropes, and lanterns.
